limitations: The graph is a typed mechanism map, not a fitted causal discovery result, Bayesian likelihood table, complete topology or aircraft safety assessment.

Only generator output, bus voltage and brief blue quantity/pressure responses are confirmed by the cited ground runs; other edges remain source-only. Grouped interventions do not validate physical exposure, and airborne responses remain unconfirmed.
Green/yellow, contactor, pump and actuator states are not included in current observations and remain unobserved during diagnosis.
Blue quantity remains on a raw scale and can refill on clearing; pressure uses inventory thresholds and scripted sources, not finite flow sharing between demand and leaks.
Normal blue electric supply uses AC bus 1, with a special ground-override branch lacking an explicit bus-voltage gate in this source.
Functional source routing and physical co-exposure are distinct edge types; synthetic regional edges assert no real A320 component proximity.
HTTP property reads and multiple control writes are not atomic; preserve per-reading timing and actual command acknowledgements.
Future diagnosis must receive observations alone, not this descriptor's intervention values or any realized private scenario label.
